title: Reserved Top Level DNS Names
summary: Sets aside a few top-level domain names such as test, example, invalid and localhost for testing and documentation, and reserves example.com, example.net and example.org as second-level names. Using them avoids clashes with real websites.

eli5.summary: When a teacher writes a sample address on a board, she uses a pretend one so no real house gets mail. These reserved names are the pretend addresses of the Internet.
